title: Axor Lab EvidenceCase
description: A curated investigation of ONE trial (Suite Platform RFC §8). EvidenceCases are GENERIC — prompt injection, hallucination, latency spike, planner failure, budget overflow, consensus failure, secret leakage, unexpected recovery. They are explicitly not limited to security. The governance chain (injection → provenance → gated call → verdict) that used to BE the EvidenceCase is now one `kind` among many, contributed by the governance capability and carried in `governance`.

kind.description: what KIND of investigation this is. Deliberately an open string, not an enum — a suite may register its own kind (RFC §17) and the platform must not have to ship a schema change for it. Known built-ins: prompt_injection, hallucination, latency_spike, planner_failure, budget_overflow, consensus_failure, secret_leakage, unexpected_recovery.

trial_ref.description: the single trial under investigation. An EvidenceCase is a VIEW over a recorded trace — it never carries its own copy of the events, so it cannot drift from what actually ran.

trace_ref.description: content hash of the frozen trace

summary.description: what happened, in prose — the Overview panel

affected_trials.description: how many trials in the run show this pattern. A COUNT of trials matching, not a claim that each was individually reviewed.

timeline.description: the ordered narrative rendered in the Timeline tab. Each entry POINTS AT a trace event by sequence rather than restating it, so the case cannot contradict the trace.

seq.description: the trace event sequence this step refers to

note.description: the investigator's annotation — the one place prose is ADDED rather than referenced

highlight.description: the step the case turns on; the Timeline renders it emphasised

metrics.description: the trial metrics worth surfacing on this case (duration_ms, steps, tokens, cost_usd, or a suite metric). Copied for display; trial.metrics in the artifact stays authoritative.

notes.description: free-form investigator notes — the Notes tab

linked_regressions.description: regression/v1 ids pinned FROM this case (the RFC's evidence → regression path)

governance.description: GOVERNANCE CAPABILITY ONLY. The provenance chain and verdict modes that used to be the whole EvidenceCase. Present only for a governance-capable run; absent for every other kind of investigation, which is the common case.

chain.description: injection → provenance → gated call → verdict, resolved from the trace's value ledger

twin_trial_id.description: the paired trial for the twin/counterfactual modes

replay_status.description: the replay outcome backing this case; an EvidenceCase claims exactly_replayable ONLY for a replayable status

explicit_flow_tracked.description: VERIFIED flow tracking, not a self-report. An untrusted client's own labels are heuristic_attribution and must not set this.
